title: Hermes tools via client-local function protocol
description: Advertises the Hermes tool surface through the client-local function protocol: a curated bare core (read_file, search_files, web_search) plus the progressive-disclosure meta-tools (hermes_tool_search / hermes_tool_describe / hermes_tool_call, mapped onto Hermes's native Tool Search bridge). Each call dispatches to the shared Hermes runtime: preferentially over the hermes-chat-lifecycle IPC (phase=tool_call, conversation-keyed, no gizmo required), falling back to the loopback HTTP tool endpoint when the lifecycle bridge is absent.
